title: Ark Query Extension
description: A2A v0.3.0 extension for passing Ark query context to execution engines.

name.description: Name of the Ark Query resource.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of the Ark Query resource.

target.description: Optional override naming the resource to execute. Sent when dispatching a single team member, whose Query targets the team rather than the member. When absent, the engine uses the Query's own spec.target.

type.description: Kind of the target resource. Only 'agent' is currently sent.

name.description: Name of the target resource, in the Query's namespace.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation scope for the sub-request, sent only alongside 'target'. Each team member receives its own value, so an engine keying per-conversation state on it does not share one bucket across members. When absent, the engine falls back to the message's contextId.
